blurb: The Basement offers private escape room games with live actors, designed to immerse guests into cinematic horror scenarios. Groups are locked in highly detailed environments where they must solve puzzles and work together to escape before time runs out. The experience focuses on suspenseful and story-driven gameplay, with realistic sets and atmospheric tension. Some experiences include interacting with characters integral to the storyline.
